description: Transformer hydrogen and oil temperature sensor with Modbus RTU
source: Electron do Brasil, Mapa de Registradores MODBUS RTU, GRIDSCAN 5000, v1.0

sources.title: Mapa de Registradores MODBUS RTU, GRIDSCAN 5000

notes: Addresses are the register numbers of the document, which starts at 0 (hydrogen at registers 0 and 1), so address_base is 0. The document lists them as holding registers (function 03).

Default connection from the document: 19200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit (the framing register also allows 2 stop bits, even and odd parity), RS-485 two-wire, unit ID 1. Set the master timeout to 10 seconds or more.
32-bit values (hydrogen, rates, calibration values) are read with the high word first. The document asks to read the high word before the low word: read both registers in one request.
Strings are ASCII, two characters per register, up to 19 characters, null-terminated. Dates are packed as month and day in one register (high and low byte) and the year in the next.
The document also describes discrete inputs (function 02, addresses 0 to 67) that repeat the status bits and mark which values are valid; they are not mapped here.
The document also says input registers 0 to 14 exist, but gives no table for them, so only holding registers are mapped.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Hydrogen
registers.description: Dissolved hydrogen in ppm H2, unscaled. Read the high word (register 0) first; the value is 0 until the ready bit of the unit status is set

registers.name: PCB temperature
registers.description: Internal temperature of the electronics; above 105 °C can damage the device

registers.name: Oil temperature
registers.description: 0 until the first measurement; the sensor is calibrated up to 105 °C

registers.name: Hydrogen rate of change per day
registers.description: Raw value is stored with an offset of 20,000,000; negative means falling hydrogen. Trends reset to zero after a power cycle

registers.name: Hydrogen rate of change per week
registers.description: Raw value is stored with an offset of 20,000,000; negative means falling hydrogen. Trends reset to zero after a power cycle

registers.name: Hydrogen rate of change per month
registers.description: Raw value is stored with an offset of 20,000,000; negative means falling hydrogen. Trends reset to zero after a power cycle

registers.name: Firmware revision
registers.description: Text in the form x:y:z (major, minor, product designator), for example 3:7:A

registers.name: Unit ready
registers.description: Hydrogen readings are valid

registers.name: New measurement available
registers.description: Cleared by reading the register

registers.name: Error
registers.description: An unrecoverable error occurred; see registers 112 and 113

registers.name: Battery backup error
registers.description: Cleared by setting the clock or cycling the power

registers.name: Command DA
registers.description: First step of the DGA adjustment: write when an oil sample is taken. Not within 24 hours of installation or of the last DC command. The document gives no value to write

registers.name: Command DB
registers.description: Second step: write after registers 126 to 129 are set. Needs a prior DA and takes up to 10 seconds to answer. The document gives no value to write

registers.name: Command DC
registers.description: Clears the DGA adjustment. The document gives no value to write

registers.name: DGA calibration hydrogen
registers.description: Laboratory hydrogen result, written before command DB

registers.name: DGA calibration month
registers.description: The date must match the internal clock for command DB to be accepted

registers.name: User-defined oil type name
registers.description: Up to 15 characters, null-terminated

registers.name: Ostwald slope m
registers.description: Stored as m x 1,000,000 + 1,000 (default 1093 for synthetic ester). A wrong value disables hydrogen measurement

registers.name: Ostwald offset b
registers.description: Stored as b x 1,000,000 + 1,000 (default 40739 for synthetic ester). A wrong value disables hydrogen measurement

registers.name: Oil type edit command
registers.description: Write 1 to open the user-defined type for editing, then 2 to save or 3 to abort

registers.name: Modbus unit ID
registers.description: Writing to unit 0 reaches every connected device. The new ID applies after a power cycle

registers.name: Operation mode
registers.description: Laboratory mode runs the self-calibration every 4 hours instead of every 12

registers.name: Parity and stop bits
registers.description: Applies after a power cycle

registers.name: Clock month
registers.description: Read register 175 first; write 175 to 178 in order, the clock is saved when 178 is written

registers.name: Clock year
registers.description: Year minus 2000 in the register

registers.name: Clock millisecond
registers.description: Write 0

registers.name: Owner ID
registers.description: Up to 19 characters; read from the lowest address, write all registers to save
